# glinet_system_info (Data Source)

Get the device and firmware information of the router (`system.get_info`). The values change only with a firmware upgrade or a reset. The serial numbers and the DDNS device ID are not available.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glinet_system_info" "router" {}

output "firmware_version" {
  value = data.glinet_system_info.router.firmware_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `board` (Attributes) OpenWrt board information (`board_info`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--board))
- `country_code` (String) Country code, for example `US`.
- `cpu_count` (Number) Number of CPUs (`cpu_num`).
- `device_type` (Number) Device type number, as the router gives it.
- `firmware_date` (String) Build date of the firmware, for example `2025-03-19 10:28:59`.
- `firmware_type` (String) Firmware type, for example `release8`.
- `firmware_version` (String) Firmware version, for example `4.7.0`.
- `hardware_features` (Attributes) Hardware of the device (`hardware_feature`). Most string values are names of devices or interfaces, for example `eth1 eth2` for `lan`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hardware_features))
- `hardware_version` (String) Hardware version. Empty when the router gives none.
- `mac` (String) MAC address of the device.
- `model` (String) Model, for example `axt1800`.
- `software_features` (Attributes) Features of the firmware (`software_feature`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--software_features))
- `vendor` (String) Vendor, for example `GL.iNet`.
